items.quote: I believe that um it's four people as a max.
items.statement: The maximum number of people that can be on a title deed in Dubai is four.

items.quote: it's not mandatory for them to be on a title deed.
items.statement: Individuals sponsoring family members for visa support do not need to include them on the title deed.

items.quote: the minimum price of registering the will in Abu Dhabi courts is one thousand five hundred dirhams.
items.statement: The minimum price for registering a will in Abu Dhabi courts is 1,500 dirhams.

items.quote: just make a will for yourself.
items.statement: To pass property ownership in a family, creating a will is recommended over worrying about the title deed.

overview: Transcript of a conversation discussing title deeds and wills in Dubai.
